llm.summary: The skill is mostly a coherent read-only SonarQube Cloud connector, but its fallback setup tells users or agents to run unverified remote installer scripts directly in a shell.

dimensions.detail: Normal operation is proportionate because it permits Bash commands limited to oo connector use, but the documented installer fallback would execute remote code locally if followed outside that narrow command surface.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: First-time setup includes direct curl-to-bash and PowerShell download-to-execute commands for installing the oo CLI, without pinning, checksum verification, signature verification, or an explicit user confirmation requirement in the skill text.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation text is broad for any SonarQube Cloud request, but the runtime instructions and available action list are scoped to searching and reading SonarQube Cloud data rather than unrelated activity.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not contain a bundled persistence mechanism, background worker, credential theft instruction, or destructive SonarQube action, but installing a CLI and logging into OOMOL are cross-session setup steps users should understand.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose is to read SonarQube Cloud data through the OOMOL oo CLI, and the listed connector actions are read-only: component measures, project listing, and issue search.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the first-time setup before installing. Prefer installing the oo CLI from a verified, pinned, or signed source and avoid running curl-to-bash or PowerShell download-to-execute commands unless you trust the OOMOL installer path and understand it will run code on your machine. Once installed, the skill's SonarQube Cloud actions are read-oriented and use OOMOL-managed credentials server-side.
llm.findings:
[SC2] unexpected: The artifact does contain the reported remote installer execution commands. Installing a required CLI is related to the skill's purpose, but executing mutable remote scripts directly is broader than necessary and insufficiently verified.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad SonarQube Cloud activation wording is present, but the allowed tool and action list constrain the skill to oo-based SonarQube Cloud reading workflows, so this is a scoping note rather than the main reason for Review.
[T03] unexpected: The static finding is supported by SKILL.md lines 57 and 61: the installer commands retrieve remote scripts and immediately execute them. This is not evidence of a bundled malicious payload, but it is a material supply-chain risk.
